# Camp Buff: Raider Speed Bag

*"Build up your raider agility with the Raider Speed Bag."*

__Overview__

A decorative CAMP item that provides a temporary Agility buff when used.

## **__Function__**

__Function__

| Item / Buff | Buff Type | Base Effect | Duration |
| Raider Speed Bag | Agility | +2 Agility | 30 minutes |

- Player Animation: Yes
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: No

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 6 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 6 per workshop
- Shelter Build Limit: 6 per Shelter
- Shares Build Limit With: Exercise Bike, Weight Bench, Antique Speed Bag
- Build Menu Category: Misc Tab
- Shelter Use: Yes
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 1

__Crafting Requirements__

- 2x Lead
- 1x Rubber
- 2x Steel

__Capacity__

- N/A

__How to Unlock__

- Atom Shop:
 - Raider Speed Bag: 500 Atoms
 - Raider Outpost Bundle: 1500 Atoms (includes Raider Speed Bag)
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

Related Links:

__Build Restrictions__

- Only available while in CAMP Mode
